convergence.comparison: pixelmatch threshold 0.1 (harness convention), per-state budget 1.0% (dispatch default); targets = NORMALIZED prototype, Chromium 151.0.7922.34 (playwright 1.58.x), deviceScaleFactor 2, viewport 1280x900, --disable-lcd-text (grayscale-AA parity, v001 rig fact), reducedMotion, network blocked, Heebo served locally from pencil/designs/fonts/Heebo-VariableFont_wght.ttf, fonts.ready awaited, double-shot self-consistency byte-identical per state. NEW RIG FACT (promote to environment facts): a real click step in a state's drive (day-selected-reopened reopens via a genuine trigger click) leaves the POINTER HOVERING the trigger — the capture protocol's pointer-parking must run AFTER the drive steps (mouse.move(0,0) + settle past the 100ms border transition), or the target banks the hover border (#8A8680) and the state fails at ~1.02%. Also observed: the trigger keeps :focus-visible after the commit-and-dismiss flow (R11 focus return) — its 3px #EBF0FE ring over the #F7F5F0 backdrop sits below the pixelmatch threshold in both selected states, consistent with the v001 converged result; no ring is authored, matching the contract descriptions.
convergence.captureGeometry: Closed states: frame = contract root #uiDp1 (200x36). Open states: frame = root ∪ popover overflow (252x288 — 36 trigger + 4 gap + 248 popover), matching the states.json declared land-stage obligation that the story wrapper enclose the open popover. The union clip admits ~0.23%/state of sibling-widget bleed (the demo box's slider column edge, page context outside the contract root) into the strip right of the 200px trigger — present identically in every open-state target, counted against the budget, not reproduced in the frames (the .pen paints $sem-background-main there).
convergence.iterationNotes: It1 (the only authoring round): v002 generated from the converged v001 approved document — state inventory and popover content are unchanged at v4.11, re-verified node-by-node against fresh normalized-render measurements (day/weekday/month/pill/ring positions identical to v001's to 0.01px) — plus the three measured v4.11 deltas: calendar icon paths at trigger (13,10) 16x16, label words +24px exact, nav chevron paths at popover-rel (18,18)/(222,18) 12x12 (FLAG-D2 rendered truth: 12x14 svg box under preserveAspectRatio meet -> 12x12 drawn content centered +1px). First compare: 5/6 pass, day-selected-reopened 1.021% — diff clustered on the trigger border; probe showed the target itself banked the HOVER border because the state's real reopen click left the pointer on the trigger (rig defect, not an authoring delta; the .pen was byte-identical across closed/reopened triggers while the two targets disagreed by 1452px). Pointer parking moved into the protocol after drive steps; the five untouched targets re-rendered byte-identical, and the same authored document measures 0.104-0.455% across all six states. v001's per-word letterSpacing compensations carried verbatim (identical strings, identical font) and hold.
